title: ME39602: Machine Design Practice
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Design Calculation and Drawings of the followings. Assignment 1: Generation of
geometric profiles of gears and cams.
( 3hrs x 2) Assignment 2: Dimensioning
concept and detail drawing of machine components. (3hrs) Assignment 3: Design
and drawing of a gear box (3hrsx4 to 5) Assignment 4: Design and Drawing of
Brake or Clutch (3hrs. x 2) Assignment 5: Design of a pressure vessel/engine
head (Mainly bolt joints) (3hrs)
